mutations.because: Moving WAVE_LOG_ROOT off /tmp to a durable ~/.waves directory prevents wave records and log history from disappearing on reboot. If it reverts to /tmp, tests fail.
Preserving existing waves under /tmp is required so in-flight waves are not lost. If LEGACY_WAVE_LOG_ROOT is not /tmp, legacy wave collection fails.
Resolving wave1-shaped directories (no dash) under legacy roots is required so in-flight waves like wave1 or waveA are found rather than duplicated into a new directory.
